import kernel as k
dev = "cuda"
# edge residue v ≡ 6 mod 7 near extremes, exact multiples, 0, max, and values around every k*7-1 boundary at top of range
vals = [0,1,6,7,13,4294967289,4294967290,4294967291,4294967292,4294967293,4294967294,4294967295,
        4294967295-6, (4294967296//7-1)*7+6 if False else 4294967290]
# all 7k-1 values at the top: v in [4294967288..4294967295] covers residues 0..6 of largest multiples

x = torch.tensor(vals, dtype=torch.int64).to(torch.uint32).to(dev)
out = k.run(x).to(torch.int64)
v = x.to(torch.int64)
row, col = out[:,0], out[:,1]
bad = []
for i in range(x.numel()):
    if not (7*row[i]+col[i] == v[i] and col[i] >= 0 and col[i] <= 6):
        bad.append(int(v[i]))
print(json.dumps({"claim":"c2","n": x.numel(), "violations": bad,

import kernel as k
dev = "cuda"
g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(7)
results = {}
for n in [1, 2, 255, 256, 257, 4093, 131071]:
    x = torch.randint(0, 1<<32, (n,), dtype=torch.int64, generator=g).to(torch.uint32).to(dev)
    out = k.run(x)
    ok_shape = tuple(out.shape) == (n,2) and out.dtype == torch.uint32 and out.is_cuda
    ref = k.reference(x)
    exact = torch.equal(out.to(torch.int64), ref.to(torch.int64))
    results[n] = {"shape_ok": ok_shape, "exact": bool(exact)}
print(json.dumps({"claim":"c3", "results": results,
 "all_pass": all(r["exact"] and r["shape_ok"] for r in results.values())}))", "expected_signal": "masked tail-block stores produce exact [N,2] output for N not divisible by 256; mismatch would confirm c3"}
